description: This file contains unit tests for the inductor implementation of the flexible attention mechanism in PyTorch, including various scenarios such as different dimensions, dynamic shapes, paged attention, and custom score/mask functions. It defines a TestFlexAttention class with multiple test cases to verify correctness and re-compilation behavior.

classes.name: TestFlexAttention
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the inductor implementation of flexible attention in various scenarios, including correctness, dynamic shapes, pagination, and custom score/mask functions.

classes.name: TestFlexAttention
classes.description: A comprehensive unit test class for the `flex_attention` function, covering correctness, shape, backprop, masking, dynamic shapes, compilation modes, custom score functions, and integration with various hardware backends.

classes.name: TestPagedAttention
